flows.name: Recipes preview, short macro
steps: Stop the attack and the cast is selected: the preview shows #showtooltip, /stopattack and /stopcasting on three lines

flows.name: Recipes preview, wrapped row
steps: Select Mark and send the pet
The preview shows all four rows; the /cast line wraps and its second row, Hunter's Mark, is indented

flows.name: Recipes preview, unlearned recipe
steps: Select Trap your mouseover (Learn at level 20)
The preview shows the whole macro with the wrapped Freezing Trap row indented, and Import is disabled
